description: What are we blind to? Lists the ATT&CK techniques no HEARTH hunt covers, optionally for one threat actor, tactic and platform (combined with AND). Gaps are parent techniques: a hunt on any sub-technique covers its parent. The techniques used by the most ATT&CK groups come first. Reconnaissance and Resource Development happen on attacker infrastructure and are left out unless asked for as the tactic. With data_sources, also lists techniques HEARTH covers but whose hunts all need data sources you don't have.

actor.description: Only this actor's techniques: name, alias or ATT&CK group id

data_sources.description: Data source categories you have: endpoint (EDR/Sysmon), windows (Windows event logs), network (firewall/flow/DNS/IDS), cloud (cloud & M365/Workspace audit), identity (AD/IdP/auth), email, web_proxy, application (SaaS/CI/web server), macos, appliance (network appliance & hypervisor logs)

include_subtechniques.description: Also list uncovered sub-techniques under their parent, including parents a hunt already covers

name: coverage_gaps

techniques.description: Techniques in the actor's ATT&CK profile

cant_run.description: With data_sources: techniques HEARTH covers, but with no hunt you can run. Same scope as gaps, so Reconnaissance and Resource Development are left out unless asked for

group_count.description: ATT&CK groups known to use it (for a parent technique, or any of its sub-techniques)

hunts.description: HEARTH hunts covering it; get_hunt for details

missing_sources.description: Data source categories those hunts use; any one makes a hunt runnable

group_count.description: ATT&CK groups known to use it (for a parent technique, or any of its sub-techniques)

has_hunt.description: With include_subtechniques: a hunt covers the parent or another sub-technique

note.description: Read this before reporting the result

other_matches.description: Other actors the name could refer to; call again with one of these ids

pre_compromise_skipped.description: Reconnaissance and Resource Development gaps left out; ask for either tactic to see them

submit_hunt.description: Present when HEARTH has no hunt for part of the request: where to submit one

techniques_in_scope.description: Parent techniques checked; 0 means nothing matched the scope, not full coverage

total_gaps.description: Parent techniques no hunt covers. With include_subtechniques, also counts covered parents that have uncovered sub-techniques (see has_hunt)

title: HEARTH coverage gaps
